about_the_game:
Microcosmum 2 is now fully released on Steam!


In the Microcosmum 2 demo, you can complete the tutorial and first missions, discovering key mechanics of this microorganism strategy game and the beginning of its story.

Microcosmum 2 is not just a sequel — it’s a new level in the evolution of the original idea. This is a full-fledged RTS with resource gathering, building, research, and territorial conquest.
Each microorganism has its own characteristics, and its antibodies influence parameters like attack power, speed, and evasion.

Microcosmum 2 is a meditative RTS about microorganisms, evolution, and construction.
It’s a unique real-time strategy (RTS) where you control alien microorganisms, build bases, and create new creatures from organism parts.
The game combines beautiful graphics with deep, relaxing gameplay.

About the Game:

Microcosmum 2 is an original RTS with creature customization and a meditative pace. You’ll experience:
  • Real-time location capture
  • Creating organisms from parts with individual stats
  • A creature editor for customization and tactical advantage
  • Base building and construction
  • Resource gathering and technology development

Story:

You are a collective mind of alien microorganisms traveling between planets for survival and evolution.
The Microcosmum 2 demo introduces the first chapter of this journey.

Organism Constructor:

Microcosmum 2 offers a unique creature creation mechanic:
  • Collect parts from defeated enemies
  • Grow organism elements in cocoons
  • Build your own microorganisms in the editor with full control over their stats

This allows for deep customization of each unit and building your own army development strategy.

Features of Microcosmum 2:

  • Unique real-time microorganism strategy
  • Meditative gameplay and relaxing game with beautiful visuals
  • Creature constructor with full customization options
  • Research, building, territorial conquest, and tech development
  • Fantastic atmosphere, pleasant music, and stylish art

Made with Heart:

Microcosmum 2 is the result of 5 years of work by two people.
This is an auteur project created for those seeking calm and unusual RTS experiences.

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Microcosmum 2 — a microorganism strategy game with meditative gameplay, beautiful visuals, and a creature creation system.
